This page contains three review sections which provide summary overviews for some of the main topics
covered in MATH 341. These reviews are intended to help sure up understanding/remembering concepts after they have been studied in detail and should not replace a full reading of the textbook and [notes](https://math341diffeq.netlify.app/notes), or attending lectures.  

- [Review 1](https://math341diffeq.netlify.app/review_01) summarizes **Chapters 1 and 2** of [@logan2015first].

- [Review 2](https://math341diffeq.netlify.app/review_02) summarizes the Laplace transform methods covered in **Chapter 3** of
[@logan2015first].

- [Review 3](https://math341diffeq.netlify.app/review_03) summarzies **Chapters 4 and 5** of
[@logan2015first].

## Access Jupyter Notebooks

Each section of the reviews has an associated Jupyter notebook, which can be run via [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/). Just click the "Open in Colab" button below for the notebook you want. The notebooks contain all of the code used in the reviews, and can be modified for exploring on your own.
